title: 2019 Panini Donruss #154 Kirk Cousins Minnesota Vikings Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Donruss sports trading card features Kirk Coussins of the Minnesota Vikings, card number 154 in the set. It is a base set card and was manufactured by Panini for the National Football League (NFL). The card is not autographed and is perfect for collectors who love football.

The card is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is perfect for fans of the Minnesota Vikings. The card is from the 2019 season and is part of the Panini Donruss set. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your collection!
